archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO / ARCADE FIGHTING GAME (KOF Aesthetics)
language: Português (BR) com termos arcade em inglês (FIGHT!, WINNER, TEAM SELECT, VS, PERFECT, ELIMINATED)

design_philosophy.emotion: Adrenaline, competitive arcade nostalgia, tactical intensity, prestige champion glory
design_philosophy.fusion: 90s/2000s KOF Fighting Game UI + Modern Esports Tournament Engine + Tactical Paintball Energy
design_philosophy.core_rule: NEVER use AI/drawn character avatars. Always display real player photos inside high-tech arcade combat cards with metallic frames, vibrant glows, and level badges.

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black uppercase tracking-wider leading-none
hierarchy.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold uppercase tracking-wide
hierarchy.arcade_badges: text-xs sm:text-sm font-extrabold uppercase tracking-widest px-2 py-0.5

player_card.styling: Relative overflow-hidden rounded-md border-2 border-slate-700 bg-slate-900 shadow-2xl transition-all duration-300 hover:scale-105 hover:border-red-500 hover:shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(255,46,76,0.5)]

badges.perfect: bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-500 via-orange-500 to-red-500 text-black font-black tracking-widest px-3 py-1 rounded shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(245,158,11,0.8)] animate-pulse
badges.mvp: bg-cyan-500 text-black font-extrabold px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(0,229,255,0.6)]

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive buttons have data-testid attributes for E2E validation.
Implement sound effects or visual sound effect toggle for standard KOF menu sounds (SELECT, VS, WINNER, FIGHT).
Player cards MUST highlight real names and photos, strictly styled like classic Arcade Fighting character select frames with bevels, level tags, and dynamic glow.
The VS screen must be full screen capable or high impact modal with split 3v3 layout, red team vs blue team glowing markers, and animated VS explosion emblem.
Support KOP LIVE fullscreen screen mode meant for TV displays/projectors with automatic live updating match scores.
Include admin authentication to draft teams, submit match scores, declare PERFECT wins, and reset tournament state.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.anti_ai_slop: Avoid generic SaaS centered card templates. Use chamfered retro-arcade containers, dark obsidian textures, neon border glows, and crisp typography.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_requirement: All buttons, inputs, navigation tabs, player card clicks, and score inputs MUST include kebab-case role-based data-testid attributes.
